verdict.rationale: Databricks documents automatic versioning for notebooks and version history for SQL queries, which are the code assets behind many automations. It also mentions git-based versioning when agents are deployed via Databricks Apps. However, nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review, or rollback for jobs or pipelines themselves. The rollback evidence covers Delta tables (data) and prompts, both adjacent subjects that earn no credit here. Missing for 10: versioning and rollback of jobs/pipelines (Lakeflow) as automation objects, a documented change-review/approval workflow for automations, explicit rollback of automation definitions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
